page.layout: One block of running text in the centre of the page; below it the closing word FINIS and a woodcut ornament; at the foot right the catchword IN-. Page number top left, running head top centre.

main_text.p: rogandam & conferuandā, prætermittere vel negligere homo mortalis non debet, nisi proprii sui corporis carnifex, tortor ac destructor perhiberi velit, quod ab homine Christiano debet esse quam longe alienum. Et certe nemo existimet, licet temperantissimè etiam circa cibum & potum versetur, non posse in corpore superfluitates inutilesque sensim humores, hoc est, ad nutrien-dum ineptos, coaceruati, qui morborum tandem causam & fomentum sint præbituri: Et tantum de proposita quæst:dixisse sufficiat.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below FINIS is a decorative border piece, not text. The word "cibum" is followed by a mark that may be a colon or ampersand; read as printed with a colon. "destructor" is printed with a ligature for "ftr"; read as structor/destructor as the ligature suggests. The "s" in "quæst" and "dixisse" is read as a long s, rendered as plain s.
